notes:
{流|なが}す means to cause something to flow, to wash away, or to broadcast.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ (intransitive, to flow)

MULTIPLE MEANINGS:
1. Let flow: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す (shed tears)
2. Wash away: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{流|なが}す (rinse with water)
3. Broadcast: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す (play music)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す: to shed tears
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す: to sweat (also figurative: work hard)
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す: to shed blood
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す: to flush the toilet
- ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す: to broadcast news
- ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}す: to spread rumors
